profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Lively and sensitive, the Swiss Hound combines a strong attachment to its handler with a determined hunting spirit. It follows scent with its nose close to the ground, working independently and giving voice along the trail. It can be a pleasant companion at home, though endurance and persistence remain hallmarks of its traditional hare and deer hunting work.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A sensitive, determined scent hunter, the Swiss Hound works with its nose low and stays closely attached to its handler.
